2019sm-1.name: Caterpie
2019sm-1.description: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

2019sm-2.name: Alolan Exeggutor
2019sm-2.description: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

attacks.name: Tropical Shake
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each type of basic Energy card in your discard pile. You can’t add more than 100 damage in this way.

2019sm-3.name: Magmar
2019sm-3.description: When angered, it spouts brilliant fire from all over its body. It doesn’t calm down until its opponent has burned to ash.

attacks.name: Controlled Burn
attacks.effect: Discard the top card of your opponent’s deck.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.effect: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

2019sm-4.name: Alolan Sandshrew
2019sm-4.description: An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still carried on to this day, is a competition to slide Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

2019sm-5.name: Lapras
2019sm-5.description: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

attacks.name: Aqua Bullet
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

2019sm-6.name: Pikachu
2019sm-6.description: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

attacks.name: Iron Tail
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

2019sm-7.name: Gastly
2019sm-7.description: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.

attacks.name: Ominous Eyes
attacks.effect: Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.

2019sm-8.name: Mankey
2019sm-8.description: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

attacks.name: Three-Step Strike
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

2019sm-9.name: Onix
2019sm-9.description: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

attacks.name: Screech
attacks.effect: During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 20 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

2019sm-10.name: Alolan Meowth
2019sm-10.description: When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.

attacks.name: Spoil the Fun
attacks.effect: If you go second, this attack does 60 more damage during your first turn.

2019sm-11.name: Alolan Dugtrio
2019sm-11.description: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

attacks.name: Gold Rush
attacks.effect: Discard any number of Metal Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 30 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

2019sm-12.name: Eevee
2019sm-12.description: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.
